name: hospitable-pages-builder
description: A website for your Hospitable listings, designed in a browser and served by one Cloudflare Worker in your own account.

HOSPITABLE_PAT.description: Your Hospitable Personal Access Token. Create one in Hospitable under Apps → API access → Personal access tokens (read access is enough). Type dummy to try everything on sample data first.

SITE_KEY.description: Paste the publish key from the builder. It can only change your site's pages, never your Hospitable data or this Worker's code.

LISTINGS.description: Stores the last good copy of your listing data. Cloudflare creates it for you.

SITE.description: Stores your published site and its last 10 versions. Cloudflare creates it for you.
